exact_statement:
For every even m>=4, every bent Boolean b on m uniform bits, distinct point edits b_u,b_v, and independent positive-width point blocks A,B of widths r,s, set g0=z*b,g1=z*b_u,g2=z*b_v and f=g0+A(g1+B(g2-g1)-g0). With alpha=2^-r,beta=2^-s,delta=2^-m,pi=(1-alpha,alpha(1-beta),alpha*beta), IC=2*r*alpha*delta+4*s*alpha*beta*delta, D=H(f)-sum pi_j H(gj), Rstar=2 sum_{i<j}pi_i*pi_j I(gi*gj), VA=2*alpha*(1-alpha)*delta*(1+(1-2*beta)^2), VB=8*alpha*beta*(1-beta)*delta,V=VA+VB, and L=VA*(2*r-2)+VB*(2*r+2*s-4)+2*alpha*(1-alpha)*delta*(1-2*beta)^2*log2(1/(1-2*beta)^2), one has |D-m*V-L-3*V/ln(2)|<=8*sqrt(delta)*V/ln(2) and Rstar<=D<=Rstar+18*IC. The coefficient of Rstar in any uniform bound D<=lambda*Rstar+K*IC with fixed finite K is necessarily lambda>=1. The nested sufficient reserve excess is exactly 2*alpha*(1-alpha)*beta*(1-beta)*I(g1*g2), equal to IC*(m-e_adj)/4 when r=s=1.
Version2 retains the preceding flat-reference expansion at exactly its stated scope and adds: for ANY Boolean seed b on m>=1 bits, distinct vertex flips u,v and the same independent balancing sign and nested point blocks, H(f)-sum pi_j H(gj)<=Rstar+(11/2+3/ln(2))*IC<Rstar+10*IC. No Fourier flatness, coefficient sign, mean or support assumption is required for this upper payment. The prior lower bound Rstar<=D is not extended to arbitrary seeds. Supplied terminal certificates H(gj)<=Cj I(gj) imply H(f)<=max(10,max_j Cj+2)*I(f). More generally, for any finite physical controller on independent uniform controls and arbitrary cores on one data cube, with row marginal q_T=E x_T^2, variance v_T=q_T-(E x_T)^2, V=sum v_T>0, actual control influence IC and raw nonempty-control entropy Hplus, H(f)-E H(g_L)<=Hplus+V log2(max_T(v_T)/V)+V/ln(2)+2IC/ln(2). If V=0 the decrement is zero. This row-profile bound does not assert a mixed-data-query drift estimate or FEI.
For exactly A025 run20261014T062819Z quadratic-bent conditional two-edit family, even m>=4, with fair nested controllers and optional common point activation of ANY width k>=0, let delta=2^-m,p=2^-k. At its obstructed x-first query retain both actual children and then resolve controls. The genuine postquery terminal surplus S8=8ITpost-HTpost satisfies S8>=p(3m+1+4k). Its SAME expected remaining bank is p(3m-1+3k)delta/4 and is at most(delta/4)S8. The positive data-query excess max(DeltaH_x-10Inf_x,0) is at most(delta/6)S8. These disjoint fixed fractions total5delta/12<=5/192, with no renewal and the activation-direction bank retained. Consequently this actual x-first history has 10I-H>=2ITpost+(1-5delta/12)S8>=0. This closes that scoped unused-surplus history payment, not a universal mixed-query induction or a new improvement of the already known family FEI constant.
hypotheses: Uniform physical cubes, Boolean signs, Shannon Fourier entropy bits and ordinary total influence.
The retained asymptotic expansion and coefficient-one lower bound have the prior even-m>=4 bent-reference hypotheses.
The new upper payment allows every Boolean seed on m>=1 bits and distinct u,v; balancing sign, two point blocks and seed coordinates are disjoint, widths r,s positive integers.
The general row-profile inequality needs only a finite label map on independent uniform controls and arbitrary Boolean cores on the shared independent data cube; zero rows have zero contribution.
No lower bound Rstar<=D for arbitrary seeds, universal child certificate, all-depth reserve payment or mixed-query release-only rule is claimed.
The x-first owner completion is restricted to the exact quadratic-bent A025 conditional two-edit family, even m>=4, fair controllers; all common activation widths k>=0 are included.
